verdict.rationale: Jeeves is a SaaS finance platform with web and mobile apps, an API and an MCP server, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics or tracking controls. The MFA and permissions items cover security, not telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
